questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer:
It was okay, the administrative aspects were handled by Massimo Costa who was very helpfull. 
The information on the courses was insufficient, it was very hard to combine relevant subjects that did not have time table conflicts

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
I knew some people who had already been to Milan on exchange, that helped a bit. My housing was very expensive but also very nice. 
I think that overall people were able to find sufficient housing.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It can be kinda scary to find accommodation by yourself. But to me it was worth it. I had the impression that people living in the study housing had cheap housing but it was also with the price of randomly selected roommates and bad locations outside of the city

Wine and coffee culture, good
People were nice

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Massimo Costa is your friend - he will help you 
2. take advantage of the possibility to change courses. Don't attend courses in different faculties if they are far away from each other, if you talk to someone and they are attending a good course consider changing. I changed courses many times in the first 3 weeks. + I changed a course right before the exam and took the course at non-attending and that is also a possibility if you have problems with one of your courses. 
3. University of Milan is confusing and very different than KU, everthing is less strict, you can change courses whenever.. go with the flow.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Do not take courses with Sacconi Lorenzo
It is really hard to find a good place to study in the weekends..

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Having fun and drinking wine in a nice city with nice people

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Stressing out about a lot of things. Not understanding a lot of the administrative stuff, having a very high price of housing....
